subject: Pilot activation: scope, data provisioning, owners & timeline
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@helianhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — Redwood trial

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can get started.

Main pain points we described:
- Summaries of patient encounter notes are taking clinicians too long to create (5–8 minutes per note).
- Current model responses have intermittent hallucinations on medication history and sometimes omit key allergies.
- End-to-end latency during peak hours spikes >1.2s (unacceptable for our clinical workflow).
- Unit cost for long-form summarization is currently materially impacting project economics.

Target goals for the pilot:
- Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 400ms on our typical request size (~500 tokens).
- Quality: factual error rate < 3% on clinical facts (measured by manual sample eval), entity extraction F1 > 0.88.
- Cost: ~50% reduction in per-1k-token cost vs our current hosted endpoint baseline.

Scope we want to pilot
1) Encounter summarization (primary): ingest de-identified notes, generate structured summary + problem list.
2) Triage classification (secondary): short label prediction for routing to specialty queues.

Immediate asks to enable data ingestion and baseline collection:
- We will share a 200-record sample of de-identified notes (attached: sample_notes_redacted.csv).
- Please provide S3 ingestion instructions, any required IAM policy, and PII-redaction guidance.
- Security: our CISO will want SOC2 evidence and details on audit logs and KMS usage — looping him in below.

Appreciate the proposed next steps you outlined on the call. Happy to schedule the kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Claire
Director of Clinical AI
Helian Health

Attachments: sample_notes_redacted.csv (csv, 200 rows, de-identified)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@helianhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — Redwood trial — action plan & owners

Claire — thanks for the clear summary and the sample. Below is a concise post-call recap and the proposed activation plan so everyone has the same reference.

Recap (what we heard)
- Use cases: encounter summarization (primary), triage classification (secondary).
- Constraints: strict PII requirements, SOC2 audit requirements, and low-latency SLA target.
- Success metrics: p50/p95 latency, reduction in per-1k-token cost, manual eval for factual accuracy and entity F1.

Pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- Baseline: ingest your sample and run baseline inference on Redwood-hosted dev runtime. Capture p50/p95 and token cost.
- Prompt/eval: provide an initial prompt suite + evaluation harness (CSV + scoring rubric) to run automated and manual checks.
- Iteration: 2 tuning cycles (prompt engineering + quantization/profile adjustments) and one final acceptance run.

Owners & internal contacts
- Rishi (sales/engage owner): overall coordination, weekly check-ins, acceptance criteria.
- Aditya (infra lead): S3/VPC access, keys, and environment provisioning.
- Monica (solutions): prompt set, eval rubric, manual review coordination.

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Day 0 (this week): exchange sample + access requirements.
- Week 1: infra setup & baseline run (Aditya owns infra tasks).
- Week 2: prompt engineering & tuning (Monica leads evals).
- Week 3: acceptance run & handoff.
- Week 4: handoff + cost/ops playbook for production readiness.

Success metrics (measurable)
- Latency: p50 < 200ms / p95 < 400ms for typical 500-token requests.
- Quality: manual factual error rate < 3% on clinical items; entity extraction F1 > 0.88.
- Cost: >= 45% reduction in cost-per-1k-tokens vs baseline.

Access & security asks from Redwood
- S3 read-only bucket or pre-signed URLs and an engineer IAM principal for ingestion.
- If your infra team requires VPC peering, share network CIDR and contact for peering.
- KMS key access pattern for encrypted buckets (we support customer-managed keys).

Attachments we are sending now
- pilot_scope_and_actions.xlsx (detailed task list + dates)
- redwood-access-instructions.pdf (S3, IAM, pre-signed URL steps and minimal network checklist)

Next steps (action items)
- Claire: confirm pilot kickoff time/date and provide S3 or sample transfer details (owner + expected file path).
- Aditya: draft infra blueprint and share by 2026-08-20.
- Monica: share initial prompt set and rubric by 2026-08-21.

Proposed kickoff: Fri 2026-08-20 09:00 PT — does that work?

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_scope_and_actions.xlsx, redwood-access-instructions.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — Redwood trial — infra checklist

Internal checklist for onboarding Helian (I'm posting here so owners are clear)

1) Network & storage
- Confirm if Helian prefers VPC peering or pre-signed S3 upload. If peering: request network CIDR, contact for peering setup.
- If pre-signed S3: ask for bucket name and object keys; we'll use our ingestion lambda with read-only presigned GETs.

2) IAM & keys
- Create an ingestion principal with least privilege: s3:GetObject for specific prefix, kms:Decrypt if CMK used.
- Generate short-lived service token for baseline run; rotate after pilot.

3) KMS & encryption
- If Helian wants CMK: provide key ARN and a KMS principal for our ingestion node.

4) Observability
- Ensure request-level tracing headers are preserved. We will export p50/p95 metrics and sample request logs (no PII by default).

5) Test environment
- Spin up a dev instance on an isolated GPU pool to run baseline (estimated 4–6 hours of run-time to process 200 records).

Deliverables & dates
- Infra blueprint (Aditya): draft by 2026-08-20.
- Prompt set (Monica): draft by 2026-08-21.
- Kickoff runbook (Rishi): final by 2026-08-20 COB.

Notes: we'll avoid any long-term storage of plaintext and default to encryption-in-transit + encryption-at-rest. If Helian requires air-gapped transfer, flag immediately.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
